justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic, outline-style figures placed in loose horizontal registers, including a band of repeated short vertical strokes (crew-strokes on the boats in A, a hatched band in B). Subject matter diverges completely, since A is dominated by boats with paired upturned prows plus a few stick-figure humans, while B shows a repertoire of animals in profile (quadrupeds in a row, a canid, a snake, a large bird) together with arms and hands on a shaped pillar.
